race.comment: TREACHEROUS DAN (7) goes on top despite the second-row draw, because his Listed placing two starts back at Globe Derby Park is the strongest recent reference in the race and he was only beaten just over five metres as a dominant odds-on favourite at Gawler on a quick back-up. MICKTHEBESTBUTCHER (1) is the clear danger on set-up, dropping out of the Listed Southern Cross Series Final into a 3 LIFETIME WINS race and drawing gate one, though the recent 47.9m gap to TREACHEROUS DAN is a significant form line to turn around. IN THE SUMMERTIME NZ (4) brings plain interstate finishing positions, but the drop from a $12,240 race into this $5,000 contest and the move to a front-row draw give him scope to improve. PLATINUM DANCER (3) earned respect with a Port Pirie win in 2 LIFETIME WINS grade and has the track-and-distance record to hold her form, though she was unwanted in the market that day and had been well beaten here the run before.
